thread:
alyssa: Postmortem follow-up (DB failover cascade) 026-03-20. Short goal: reduce noisy pages from recurring latency spikes and close remediation items. I dropped a short tracker: https://short.link/redwood-postmortem-actions. Please claim an item and add ETA.

 devon: I'll take the API tail-latency tuning. Plan: move from a single absolute threshold to a percentile-based rule + increase `for` window to avoid blips. ETA: 3 business days.

 kevin: I'll own kvcache alert dedupe + suppression. Thinking: dedupe on `cache_key_prefix` and a short suppression window (10m) for fanouts. Need last 14 days of alerts to validate.

 sara: +1. For escalation policy, suggest "notice" -> slack thread (no page), "alert" -> ticket + escalation to SRE, "critical" -> page. We should disable auto-paging for the "alert" tier while we iterate.

 devon: Draft Prom rule (placeholder):
```
alert: api_tail_latency_p95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_bucket[5m])) by (le, service)) > 0.5
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: alert
  team: api
annotations:
  summary: "API p95 latency high for service={{ $labels.service }}"
```
I'll add an `owner=devon` label and put the old rule in a PR for rollback.

 kevin: For dedupe, regex we use to compact keys: `^user:\d+:session` -> `user:session`. We'll start with exact-match dedupe using `dedupe_key=cache_key_prefix` then evaluate probabilistic dedupe after 2 weeks.

 ops-bot: Task created: PM-4332 "Tune api_tail_latency_p95" assigned to @devon, due 2026-04-06.

 alyssa: Canary plan: enable new rules in eu-central-1 for 24h, watch `pages/hour` and `alerts->tickets` ratio. If pages drop by >50% with stable user impact, roll to remaining regions. Maria will set up the canary dashboard (cc @sara).

 sara: I'll coordinate the dashboard and a short runbook blurb for the SRE rotation that explains the new severity tiers. Also will schedule a 15m sync next Tue 10am PT to review canary metrics.

 devon: Opening PR for rule changes and will include rollback snippet + query to compare triggers before/after. Posting PR link here when ready.

 kevin: I'll add a suppression test script to the tracker that simulates fanout bursts so we can confirm suppression window doesn't hide real incidents.

 alyssa: Owner check: devon (api thresholds), kevin (kvcache dedupe/suppression), sara (dashboard + runbook), alyssa (tracker + follow-up meeting). Please update the tracker with actual ETA and mark blocked if you need data. We'll close items once PR merged and canary looks stable.

 devon: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/ops-alerts/pull/412 (contains new percentile rule + notes).

 kevin: Added historical counts (14d) and suppression script link in tracker.

 sara: Thanks everyone. I'll mark PM ticket status and we will revisit in the scheduled sync. Ping me directly if anything blocks removal of pages. :white_check_mark:
